name: Okto Shareable Draft Previews
author: oktohut

sections.description:
Okto Shareable Draft Previews lets you generate secure, time-limited preview links for draft posts and pages.

Perfect for:
– Sending drafts to clients for review
– Getting feedback before publishing
– Collaborating with editors or team members

Features:
– One-click link generation from post editor
– Automatic expiry (24h, 48h, 7 days, 30 days, or custom)
– Global default expiry + per-link override
– Beautiful admin panel to manage all links
– Search, pagination, quick edit titles/labels
– Copy link with one click
– Works with posts, pages, and custom post types
– No login required for viewers

Secure, clean, and 100% WordPress-native.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the okto-shareable-draft-previews folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to OSDP menu (top-level) in admin to manage links and set default expiry

That’s it! Start sharing drafts securely.
sections.faq:
How do I create a preview link?

Just edit any draft post/page — you’ll see a “Shareable Preview” metabox with a “Generate Link” button.

Can I change when links expire?

Yes! Set a global default in SDP → Settings, or override per-link in the admin panel.

Are the links secure?

Yes. Each link uses a random 16-character token. Expired/revoked links show a clean “Link expired” message.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes! Works with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, etc.
